declarations.name: summarize_numbers
declarations.description: Count, mean, min and max of a list of numbers.

declarations.name: insights
declarations.description: Answers questions about numbers using Python tools.

agent.instructions: Use summarize_numbers for statistics. Answer briefly.

declarations.name: face_model
declarations.description: The embedding model id; stored embeddings from other models need re-enrollment.

declarations.name: face_load_gallery
declarations.description: Decrypt and cache the signed-in user's gallery: people = [{id, name, ciphertexts}].

declarations.name: face_recognize
declarations.description: Detect every face in a base64 JPEG/PNG and match each against the cached gallery.

declarations.name: face_enroll_start
declarations.description: Start a guided enrollment session (pass person_id to re-enroll an existing person).

declarations.name: face_enroll_sample
declarations.description: Check one camera frame and, if it is usable, add its face to the enrollment session.

declarations.name: face_enroll_finish
declarations.description: Validate an enrollment session and return its encrypted embeddings for storage.

declarations.name: face_enroll_cancel
declarations.description: Discard an enrollment session and its in-memory samples.

declarations.name: face_forget
declarations.description: Drop in-memory state for the signed-in user (or only one person's debouncing state).
